question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (Akademi Puraskar) for the year 2020 was awarded to Meenakshi Chitharanjan for her contribution to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (Akademi Puraskar) for the year 2020 was awarded to Meenakshi Chitharanjan for her contribution to Bharatanatyam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, also known as the Akademi Puraskar, is the highest national recognition given to practicing artists in India. The award is bestowed by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama, which is an autonomous body of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.

Here are some key points about the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:

 
• Establishment: The award was established in 1952 and is conferred by the President of India.
 
• Fields of Recognition: It recognizes outstanding contributions in the field of music, dance, and drama/theatre. The music category includes Carnatic music, Hindustani music, and other traditional music forms. Dance recognitions include major Indian classical dance forms and folk dances. Drama recognition spans from playwriting to acting, directing, and even puppetry.
 
• Components of the Award: The award comprises a purse of Rs. 1,00,000, a citation, an angavastram (a ceremonial shawl), and a tamrapatra (a brass plaque).
 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar: This is a special award by the Sangeet Natak Akademi to recognize and encourage outstanding young talents in the field of performing arts.
 
• Fellowship of the academy: The Fellowship of the Sangeet Natak Akademi, restricted to a very limited number at a given time, is the highest honour in the performing arts conferred by the Government of India.
 
• Awarding Process: The General Council of the Akademi makes the final decision regarding the awardees, based on the recommendations of its advisory committees.
